purpose: Causal same-tape training test of one conservatively shrunk CPU-service-backlog correction after the complete V185 training failure.

diagnostic_evidence.failure_concentration: The largest losses occur when candidate-relative task-count scoring increases high-density residence and pressure; the full-strength correction is not robust.

scale_audit.conclusion: Direct x/(1+x) CPU-service normalization would remain saturated; a bounded candidate-relative signal must be conservatively shrunk toward the frozen OCS task-count score.

mechanistic_hypothesis.single_intervention: At operational queue density at least 8 only, replace the frozen OCS normalized-load scalar by 0.75 times its original task_count/(1+task_count) value plus 0.25 times candidate_cpu_service_backlog/max_feasible_candidate_cpu_service_backlog. CPU-service backlog is (pending immutable CPU work + all resident remaining CPU work + immutable CPU work of already projected same-window assignments) divided by node CPU capacity. Below 8 retain the exact V182 Hiku2/OCS Borda branch.
mechanistic_hypothesis.why_shrinkage_is_principled: The frozen OCS load term weighs 0.15. Convex shrinkage preserves 75 percent of its validated task-count signal and caps the new service-aware correction at one quarter of that term after V185 demonstrated that a full-strength relative signal overcorrects.
mechanistic_hypothesis.fallback: If any required CPU-work snapshot, function profile, projected assignment, or CPU capacity is unavailable or invalid, use the exact frozen V184 OCS penalty for that candidate.

candidate.tape_reuse: Reuse the immutable V184 E1590-E1609 base tapes after hash verification.
candidate.control_reuse: Reuse all twenty immutable V184 candidate summaries as the paired control; do not rerun V182 or any baseline.
candidate.reference_action: Build or bind policy-independent references only through the fail-closed protocol dependency rules for the new runtime identity.

disposition.on_pass: Freeze the candidate as training winner and preregister a later disjoint NSESche-only confirmation cohort; do not claim low closure from E1590-E1609.
disposition.on_fail: Retain the complete cohort, seal a failure receipt, close this mechanism axis, and continue first-principles diagnosis without advancing to middle.
